decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric builds directly on the firm's core upholstery know-how and still has its own website page, so management can read its market response and refine it through in-house development rather than drop it.

The semi-transparent bouclé decorative fabric fits the firm's established decoration expertise, but it is only mentioned on the website and its sibling bouclé leno product was already withdrawn, which raises the risk of pruning, though not enough to justify dropping it now.
Flame-retardant jacquard curtains match the firm's functional-fabric knowledge and its contract and hospitality strategy, so the firm can absorb project feedback and keep improving the product.

The braided-structure fabric is a recent launch that builds on established upholstery and curtain competence and has its own page, so the firm should keep learning from its early results before judging it.
